name: askjev-mcp
description: Bridge Claude Desktop to the AskJev browser extension — Autopilot + Guard over localhost.
long_description:
AskJev connects Claude Desktop to your Chrome/Brave AskJev extension so Claude can drive the active tab with the same irreversible-click Guard.

1. Install this extension in Claude Desktop.
2. Paste the pairing token from AskJev Options → Advanced.
3. Keep the AskJev Chrome extension open with Agent Bridge armed.

No daily terminal. Traffic stays on 127.0.0.1.

tools.name: askjev_start_goal
tools.description: Start Autopilot on the active tab with a natural-language goal

tools.name: askjev_snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot interactive elements on the active tab

tools.name: askjev_act
tools.description: Execute one DOM action (rate-limited; Guard applies)

askjev_token.title: AskJev pairing token
askjev_token.description: From AskJev Options → Advanced → Copy token (after Auto-connect).

askjev_port.title: Bridge port
askjev_port.description: Must match AskJev Options → Bridge port.
